title: mlconv: calibrated detection of convergent gene loss and rate shifts (code for "Calibrated genome scans find recurrent gene loss in marine and subterranean mammals")
description: Code for the article Calibrated genome scans find recurrent gene loss in marine and subterranean mammals. A convergence test that learns its null covariance from all genes (GLS), requires every signal to survive the removal of each independent origin, tests gene loss against a simulated irreversible-loss null with species and gene annotation error, and is repeated on matched control traits. Includes the analyses of 115 mammals (Zoonomia/TOGA), the AliSim benchmarks, the RERconverge comparison, and the code that draws every figure. Derived data are deposited separately (see related identifiers).
